pairs.difference: B: the binocular barrels form one large near-black mass, with hard white rim highlights on the gold rings and lens glass. That is the hard local contrast the generated lesson cards show (lesson glove and camera). The pink diamond background drops to a dark group at the corners, so the hero sits in a mid-grey pool. A: the fan is flat. Its pleats alternate in mid and dark bands with soft edges against a bright, high-key yellow field, and it has no specular punch. That is closer to the real anchor cards' broad, gentle shading.
pairs.fix: Shade the binocular barrels in mid-dark leather tones, not pure black. Keep the brass rims soft-lit with one small highlight each. Keep the pink background even, with no darkening toward the corners.

pairs.difference: A: the wicker basket breaks into many small hard light and dark cells. Every weave strand has a white top and a dark gap, and the lid edge is crisp and bright. That is busy high-frequency local contrast inside the hero, like the generated lesson cards. B: the gloves are big soft mid-dark red masses with one soft highlight each, against a dark blue striped wall. The center is darker than the corners (vignette -0.103), which is unusual, but the hero shading is broad and gentle.
pairs.fix: Paint the wicker as broad soft bands with gentle shading. Leave out bright highlights on every strand. Let the top face read as one lighter plane and the front as one middle tone.

pairs.difference: A: the parasol canopy sits mid-dark, with a ring of pure-white lace scallops and white highlight specks on the brown ball tips. These are many small, hard light accents scattered around the hero edge. rms 0.078 is below the real range, so the card is flat overall apart from those specks. B: the beach umbrella shows large clean value groups. The yellow panel is one big light mass and the under-panels are one dark mass, with broad, simple roll-off.
pairs.fix: Group the parasol into a lit top half and a shaded underside. Tone the lace down to a soft cream that is a step lighter than the canopy, not bright white. Drop the small white glints on the ball tips.

pairs.difference: B: the white bench is almost all clipped white. Its key (0.756) is above the real range, and it sits on a speckled gravel path that breaks into salt-and-pepper light and dark noise. Separation comes from pure white against noise, not from grouped shadow shapes. A: the swing has a light canopy, a mid-dark wooden frame and one cast-shadow pool under the seat. The value groups are readable.
pairs.fix: Shade the bench's back slats and legs with a soft cool shadow side so it is not uniformly white. Make the path a smooth, even mid-tone with only faint pebbles.

pairs.difference: B: the keyboard sits in a darkened field with darker corners and a pale glow patch behind it. Its black keys and dark body edge give crisp near-black against white key accents. A: the coaster cars are large light yellow masses with soft grey shading on a light sky. Its vignette (0.117) is slightly high, but the groups are broad and simple.
pairs.fix: Make the blue background an even tone with no glow behind the keyboard and no darkening corners. Soften the keyboard's black edge to a dark grey.

pairs.difference: B: a dark grey top hat stands against a near-white burst glow. The lightness gap (-0.364) and rms (0.195) are both outside the real range. The crown carries a hard streaked sheen with dark and bright vertical bands. A: the scout jacket is a light mid-tone hero against a dark green field, with soft, gentle internal shading. Its vignette is a bit high, but its groups match the real cards.
pairs.fix: Paint the top hat in a softer mid-grey with a gentle gradient from the lit side to the shadow side, with no streaky shine. Keep the yellow ray background an even mid-bright tone, without a white glow behind the hat.

pairs.difference: Both cards are high-key (0.776 and 0.783, above the real range). A: a white teacup on a white tablecloth, with a pale glow behind it in the green stripes. The hero barely separates by value. The tea pool is the only dark accent, and the gold rim adds thin bright lines. B: the fountain is also light, but its basins carry a consistent light top and darker under-rim, and the pool ring forms a mid-dark band.
pairs.fix: Give the cloth a mid tone a step darker than the cup, and remove the glow behind the cup. Give the cup a clear shadow side on the right.

pairs.difference: A: the stone wall is near clipped white over most of the card (key 0.759, above range), and the door is a solid near-black slab in the middle. Vignette is 0.2, far outside range: dark leaf clumps sit in all the upper corners. It reads as a hard two-value poster. B: the blue door is a middle-dark mass with a mid-tone wreath and leaves on the frame. The steps between values are more even.
pairs.fix: Tone the wall down to a warm mid-light beige with soft shading. Paint the door a mid-dark red with visible panel shading instead of solid black. Keep the ivy in the corners at a mid tone.

pairs.difference: B: a dark brown-black spyglass sits on a pale cyan field. The key (0.79) is above range and the gap (-0.287) is well below it. The tube has hard gold rings and a bright white lens glint, so it is a near-black hero on a near-white ground. A: the golf club and ball are light mid-tones in a mid-value grass scene, with soft groups.
pairs.fix: Paint the spyglass leather in a warm mid-brown, with brass rings in soft gold, not bright highlights. Make the cyan background a medium tone, darker than now.

pairs.difference: B: a white teapot sits in a pale glow patch, while the purple corners drop to a dark value group, so the light glow sits behind the hero. Inside the pot, the roses form crisp mid-dark patches on bright white porcelain. A: the vending machine is a dark mass on a mid-light field with gentle roll-off. Its glass front is the light group.
pairs.fix: Keep the purple background one even mid tone into the corners, with no glow halo behind the teapot. Give the porcelain a soft grey shadow side.

pairs.difference: B: the straw hat brim is a light mass of fine, hard white-and-grey weave lines, mostly the same value as the light-green wave background. The hero separates by hue more than by value, and the dark ribbon and bow are the only dark group. A: the red scarf is a clear mid-dark mass against a lighter swirl, with a single bright badge accent and soft, broad fold shading.
pairs.fix: Paint the straw hat with smooth, soft shading: a lit top crown and a darker under-brim. Draw the straw texture lightly. Make the green background a step darker so the hat stands out by brightness.

pairs.difference: B: the pram basket is one near-black navy mass (gap -0.199). The wheels and frame are hard chrome lines with white glints, over cobblestones broken into many crisp light and dark tiles. A: the taxi is a light hero with soft grey shading in front of ray bands, with simple groups. Its vignette (0.096) is slightly high.
pairs.fix: Paint the pram basket in a mid navy with a soft lit top edge. Make the chrome dull grey without white glints. Make the cobblestones a smooth mid tone with faint joints.

pattern: On the value lens, the generated cards share a few patterns. The prop is a hard near-black mass (spyglass, top hat, binoculars, pram, red door) in front of a glow that is near white. The hero carries scattered pure-white glints or busy light-and-dark texture: lace, wicker, straw, cobbles, gravel. Some cards show darkening corners with a pale halo behind the hero. In others the hero is white on white, separated only by hue. Real cards keep broad, gentle shading inside the hero and an even background.
